scope: Offline post-hoc exploratory analysis, no model training or engine execution
checks: All final shadow arrays re-quantize exactly to saved integer models; all six stored test prediction arrays and train/validation own-target MAE recompute exactly
averaging: seed_mean_metrics averages the per-model metrics of the three paired batch-order seeds. Other grouped prediction metrics and row-residuals use mean predictions only for descriptive visualization; they are not an evaluated ensemble.
limits: Own target MAE values of A and B use different labels and cannot choose a winner
100k reference shares B's teacher and is not objective truth
Search-data strata are not randomized interventions
Only terminal float weights and integer models exist; no validation curves by epoch
